sections.title: Executive Leadership
sections.description: This course covers the essentials to help you become a more dynamic leader who knows what to do in uncertain situations. Through applicable readings, applied exercises, assessments, and personal leadership development, students will develop skills in communicating with authenticity and influence, leading with Emotional Intelligence, building productive working relationships, networking across organizations, and making high-impact decisions.

sections.title: Executive Leadership
sections.description: This course will teach you to become a dynamic leader who knows what to do in uncertain situations. Through applied exercises, individualized assessments and coaching, and personal leadership development, students will develop skills in inclusive leadership, building productive working relationships, hiring and human resources, intercultural communication, dialoguing across difference, crisis management, and messaging.
